item.title: Jamumu grappling with most polluted Dec; AQI even touching 360 today
item.description: NAVVNEET DUBEY Jammu: The rainfall in Jammu region has failed to improve the air quality as AQI of the city dipped into ‘ poor’ category on Monday. Data from AQI.in, showed the Air Quality Index (AQI) in Jammu remained in the very poor category at 360 at 11 AM, however on an average the winter capital recorded 225 AQI today. item.title: Leopard enters CRPF Camp in South Kashmir, Jawan injured
item.description: SRINAGAR: Panic gripped in a CRPF camp in Kapran area Anantnag in South Kashmir on Wednesday morning after a leopard entered the premises and attacked personnel during breakfast hours, leaving one jawan injured. Official said that the incident occurred in the morning hours at the Kapran camp, when jawans were assembled in the mess for breakfast. Suddenly, a leopard strayed into the camp and attacked the personnel. During the incident, one jawan identified as HC Kamlesh Kumar sustained injuries.

item.title: Avalanche warning issued for five districts in J-K
item.description: Srinagar, Dec 24: An avalanche warning was issued in five districts of Jammu and Kashmir on Wednesday in view of the recent heavy snowfall in the higher reaches of the Union territory, officials said. The low danger avalanche warning has been issued for Doda, Ganderbal, Kishtwar, Poonch and Ramban districts. The avalanche is likely to occur 2,800 metres above these districts during the next 24 hours, they said. People have been asked to avoid avalanche-prone areas and follow official advisories.
